 Charlotte forward Rodolfo Aloko (37), left, does a flip after scoring a goal to tie the game against Inter Miami during the second half of an MLS game Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026, in Miami, Fla.
 Marta Lavandier - AP 
 As featured on
 +4 
 Charlotte FC rallies from 3-goal deficit to draw Inter Miami 3-3 in regular-season finale 
 Lionel Messi was held scoreless as Inter Miami blew a three-goal halftime lead and drew 3-3 with Charlotte FC on Saturday in its Major League Soccer regular-season finale. Messi finished the season with 26 goals and is poised to become the first player in MLS history to win back-to-back Golden Boots. Miami is the No. 2 seed in the Eastern Conference playoffs and Charlotte is the 5 seed. The first round begins Nov. 20. Ian Fray, Luis Suárez and Rodrigo De Paul scored for Miami, and Liel Abada scored twice for Charlotte in the second half before Rodolfo Aloko tied it in the 90th minute.
